description: Check up to 25 Belgian companies (enterprise or VAT numbers) for Peppol receivability under both Belgian IDs — 0208 (enterprise number) and 9925 (VAT number). Returns per company: receivable under both, only 0208, only 9925, neither, or unknown, with the risk and what to fix in Dutch, French or English. Uses one metered call per valid company; unreadable numbers are free. Requires an InvoiceVerify account (OAuth sign-in).

companies.description: 1 to 25 Belgian enterprise or VAT numbers (strings or {id, name}). Split longer lists into several calls.

id.description: Enterprise or VAT number, e.g. BE0403170701 or 0403.170.701

name.description: Optional client name to echo back

lang.description: Language of the explanations: en (default), nl or fr.

name: check_belgian_peppol_list
title: Check a Belgian client list on Peppol
